## Training procedure

We first tokenise the inputs, then fine-tune the model for 40 epochs, and finally select the best checkpoint.

## Experimental setup

All experiments run on 4 NVIDIA V100 GPUs with 32GB memory each, using PyTorch 2.1.0. We use AdamW with a learning rate of 0.05, a batch size of 64 and a weight decay of 0.01.

## Data

We use the GLUE benchmark (version 2.0), split into 80% train, 10% validation and 10% test.

## Baselines

We compare against the BERT-base baseline under the same training budget.

## Reproducibility

Our results are fully reproducible.
